surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the self-limiting surface reactions between the adsorbed precursors and reactants, where the precursor pulse time and reactant pulse time were optimized to achieve self-limiting growth behavior. The use of H2 plasma as a reactant enabled the reduction of TiNp4 to produce high-quality TiCx films.
